title: DocumentJSON v1.0
description: MX White Paper 단일 진실 공급원(SSOT). Section 트리(level 1~3) + Block 배열 본문. PROJECT_PLAN.md / Plan / Design / Do 문서의 모든 데이터 모델 참조처.

sections.description: 최상위 섹션은 반드시 level=1 (BE 가 검증). 자식 섹션은 부모 level+1.

variables.description: Map of variable names → fill-in strings used to substitute {{var}} tokens at render time.

custom_css.description: Optional CSS injected into the doc's render. Sandboxed: no <script>, no expression(), no url(javascript:), no @import, no behavior:.

ImageRef.description: FK to images.id — accepts ULID (legacy seed data) or UUID (uploaded images)

Slug.description: url-safe identifier (lowercase ASCII, digits, hyphen, Hangul)

Infobox.description: 우상단 정보 박스. 키=라벨, 값=문자열, 문자열 배열, 또는 풍부한 표현(링크/뱃지/아이콘)을 위한 InfoboxRich 객체. 기존 문자열 형태는 그대로 호환.

InfoboxRich.description: Richer Infobox value — wraps a label with optional link / badge / icon / color hints. Used wherever a plain string isn't enough (예: 상태 뱃지, 담당자 메일 링크).

href.description: 링크 URL — 있으면 텍스트가 클릭 가능한 a 태그로 렌더링.

badge.description: 배경/텍스트 컬러로 강조하는 뱃지 종류. neutral=회색.

color.description: 텍스트 색 직접 지정 (badge와 함께 쓰면 badge가 우선).

Section.description: Document outline node. Recursive — `subsections` is another Section[]. Top-level entries MUST have level=1; child level = parent.level + 1 (enforced by the BE renumber/validate pass). The visual rendering caps at HTML <h6> (level 5+ all render as h6) but schema-wise depth is unbounded.

number.description: 1.2.3.4… dotted ordinal recomputed by the BE on every save.

level.description: 1-based depth. BE rejects values that don't match the tree position.

layout.description: Visual layout for this section's blocks. Drives both the wiki view (block arrangement inside the section) and presentation view (slide template). Defaults to 'stack' (existing behaviour: blocks render top-to-bottom). 'two-col' splits blocks alternately into two columns. 'image-left'/'image-right' put the first ImageBlock on one side and remaining blocks on the other. 'title-only' renders just the section heading (PPT cover style). 'full-bleed' uses the first ImageBlock as a full-width background with subsequent blocks overlaid.

layoutWidths.description: Per-pane percentage widths for two-pane layouts (two-col / image-left / image-right). Length MUST equal 2 when present, each value 10..90, sum SHOULD equal 100 (FE normalises). Ignored for stack / title-only / full-bleed. Omit for equal 50/50 split.

level.description: Heading 블록(heading-4 type)에서 실제 보여줄 단계. 2=큰 제목, 3=중간 제목, 4=작은 제목(기본). 다른 블록 타입에서는 무시됨.

width.description: 사용자 지정 블록 너비(px). 미지정 또는 0이면 부모 컨테이너에 맞춤(기존 동작).

height.description: 사용자 지정 블록 높이(px). 미지정이면 콘텐츠 자동 높이(기존 동작).

audience.description: 이 블록이 노출되는 뷰. 'both'(기본): 위키 + 슬라이드 둘 다. 'wiki-only': 위키에만 (프레젠테이션에서 숨김). 'slide-only': 프레젠테이션에서만 (위키 본문에서는 숨김). 발표용 큰 이미지/스피커 멘트, 또는 위키엔 자세히 적고 슬라이드엔 빼고 싶은 표 등을 분리할 때 사용.

slideBreak.description: 프레젠테이션 모드에서 사용자가 명시적으로 슬라이드 분할 지점을 지정. 'before': 이 블록부터 새 슬라이드 시작. 'after': 이 블록 다음부터 새 슬라이드 시작. buildSlides 의 자동 BUDGET 분할보다 우선. 같은 섹션 안에서 발표자 흐름을 직접 제어할 때 사용.

CellBlock.description: Block subset allowed inside a TableBlock cell's `blocks` array. Intentionally narrow to keep table cell rendering tractable — only paragraph/image/list.

level.description: Visual heading level. Optional — defaults to 4 (smallest). Sub-section heading; the document outline still uses Section nodes for the canonical hierarchy.

options.description: 표시 옵션. 모두 optional, default 동작은 ON.

stripe.description: 행 단위 zebra-striping. false 일 때만 OFF — 옛 문서 (옵션 미지정) 는 ON 유지. 중첩 항목 (depth>=1) 은 stripe 미적용.

TableBlock.description: Table block. Two layout modes: flat (`headers` + `rows`, the common case) and sparse (`cells`, used whenever cells are merged or styled per-cell). The renderer prefers `cells` when present. Optional `columns` carries per-column metadata (width / align / dtype / format) that applies to BOTH modes — column index is well-defined in either layout.

caption.description: Optional caption rendered below the table; participates in auto-numbering ('표 N: ...').

cells.description: Optional sparse cell list for tables with merged or styled cells (DOCX gridSpan/vMerge round-trip + per-cell style overrides). When present, the renderer ignores headers/rows and lays out from this list. Each cell occupies (r..r+rowSpan-1) × (c..c+colSpan-1); covered slots have no entry. r/c are 0-indexed; the first row of a header-mode table is the header row. A cell carries content via either `text` (plain string, the common case) or `blocks` (mixed content — paragraph/image/list). Exactly one of the two MUST be set; empty cell ⇒ text=''.

blocks.description: Mixed-content cell payload. When present, renderers ignore `text` and lay out these blocks inside the cell. Restricted to paragraph/image/list to keep cell layout tractable — tables-in-tables and callouts-in-cells are intentionally out of scope.

align.description: Per-cell horizontal alignment override (wins over column default).

columns.description: Optional per-column metadata. Index matches column index in both flat and sparse layouts. Missing entries fall back to defaults (left-align, text dtype, auto width).

align.description: Default cell alignment for this column. dtype=number|percent|currency auto-defaults to right when align is unset.

dtype.description: Column data type. Drives auto-formatting and default alignment.

format.description: Format hint. number/percent: decimal places like '2'. currency: ISO code or symbol like 'KRW' / '$'. date: pattern like 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

footer.description: Optional footer row showing per-column aggregates. Computed at render time from `rows` (flat mode) — sparse mode is skipped because merged-cell semantics make column-wise sums ambiguous.

label.description: Label shown in the first column when no aggregate is set there.

sortable.description: Header click sorts asc/desc by that column (flat mode only).

searchable.description: Show a search box above the table that filters rows (flat mode only).

stickyFirstCol.description: Pin the first column when the table scrolls horizontally.

rowNumbers.description: Show 1-based row numbers in a leading column.

stripe.description: Zebra-striped rows. Default true; set false to disable.

options.description: 표시 옵션. 모두 optional, default 동작은 ON.

stripe.description: 카드 단위 zebra-striping (`:nth-of-type(2n)`). grid 컬럼 수와 무관 — 카드 한 칸 건너 한 칸 음영.

ChartBlock.description: Chart block — `engine` selects the renderer. 'recharts' (default) uses our existing simple chart UI; 'echarts' unlocks rich interaction (zoom, brush, hover slope, markPoint annotations, markArea regions). With 'echarts' the data fields below still drive the dataset, but `options` accepts any ECharts EChartsOption fragment that gets merged on top.

chartType.description: 차트 타입. 'xy-line' 은 시리즈마다 자유로운 (x, y) 쌍 — labels 공유 안 함. 두 stress-strain 곡선처럼 시료별 측정점이 다른 데이터를 한 그림에 겹쳐 비교할 때 사용. data.labels 는 무시되고 각 series 의 points: [{x, y}] 가 그려진다.

engine.description: Chart renderer. Default 'recharts' for back-compat; choose 'echarts' for rich interactivity (markPoint / markArea / brush / dataZoom).

values.description: labels 와 동일 길이의 y 값. chartType=='xy-line' 이면 무시되고 points 사용.

points.description: 자유 (x, y) 쌍. chartType=='xy-line' 에서 사용. 시리즈마다 x 가 다를 수 있어 stress-strain 곡선처럼 측정점이 다른 데이터 비교 가능. 각 점에 optional err (대칭 error bar y±err) 또는 errLow/errHigh (비대칭) 가능 — 측정 오차 시각화.

caption.description: 시리즈 추가 설명 — hover/legend 에 표시. 캡션은 사용자가 paste 시 헤더에서 추출하거나 직접 입력.

yAxisIndex.description: 이 시리즈가 그려질 y 축. 0 (기본) = 왼쪽 축, 1 = 오른쪽 축. dual-axis 일 때 단위가 다른 두 시리즈를 같은 차트에 표시.

color.description: 시리즈 색상 override. 미지정 시 PALETTE 자동. CSS 색 (#RGB, rgb(), name).

xAxisLabel.description: x 축 라벨. xy-line 처럼 카테고리가 아닌 연속값일 때 의미. paste 의 'x' 헤더 컬럼명에서 자동 추출 가능.

yAxisLabel.description: y 축 라벨. paste 의 'y' 헤더 컬럼명에서 자동 추출 가능.

yAxisLabel2.description: 오른쪽 y 축 라벨 — dual-axis 일 때 (series 중 yAxisIndex=1 있을 때) 사용.

xAxisType.description: x 축 데이터 유형. 'time' 이면 unix ms 또는 ISO date 로 해석 (P3 — timestamp x). 미지정 = 'value' (숫자).

interactions.description: Friendly knobs for ECharts interactivity that map onto markPoint / markArea / dataZoom without requiring users to write raw EChartsOption.

keyPoints.description: Highlighted points on the curve (label, x-index, optional color).

regions.description: Coloured x-range bands (e.g. Elastic / Plastic). xFromIndex / xToIndex are inclusive label indexes.

showZoom.description: Inline dataZoom slider under the chart.

options.description: Raw ECharts EChartsOption fragment, merged after `interactions` so power users can override anything.

display.description: 사용자 시각화 토글 상태. 차트 블록과 함께 저장되어 재방문 시 동일 상태 복원. P1 에서 gridOn/xLog/yLog/showFit + 자동 zoom 지원, P2 에서 fitRange/축범위/stats, P3 에서 fitType/도메인 옵션 확장.

fitType.description: 피팅 모델. P1 은 linear 만, P3 에서 나머지.

annotations.description: 차트 위 도형 (P3) — 사용자가 데이터 좌표계에 직접 얹는 화살표/박스/마커/노트. ImageAnnotation 의 카운터파트이지만 좌표가 (x, y) 데이터 단위.

options.description: 표시 옵션. 모두 optional, default 동작은 ON.

stripe.description: task row 단위 zebra-striping (label 영역 포함 전체 행). SVG `<rect fill='#F9FAFB'>` 로 paint.

IframeBlock.description: Embed an external page (`src`) OR an inline self-contained HTML document (`html`). Exactly one MUST be set. The renderer wraps the iframe in a sandbox boundary so the embed can't reach the parent DOM, cookies, or storage; only `allow-scripts` is granted so interactive embeds (charts, calculators) still work.

src.description: 사내 화이트리스트 도메인만. `html` 와 동시 사용 금지.

html.description: Self-contained HTML document. Rendered via iframe srcdoc + sandbox. Use this for ad-hoc interactive embeds (e.g. canvas-based charts) that don't need a hosting URL. `src` 와 동시 사용 금지.

autoplay.description: Auto-play on load. Browser autoplay policies may block this when muted=false; treat as a hint.

loop.description: Restart automatically when the video ends.

file_id.description: FK to files table (mxwp-files); served via /api/v1/files/:file_id/download

widths.description: Optional per-column widths as percentages of the row. Length MUST equal columns.length when present, each value 5..95, and the sum SHOULD equal 100 (server normalises). Omit for equal split.

FigureIndexBlock.description: Auto-generated table of figures (그림/표/차트 목차). The renderer walks the document and lists every captioned image, table (with caption), and chart (with title), each linked to its anchor. `kinds` controls which lists to render.

kinds.description: Which figure types to include — 'image' (그림), 'table' (표), 'chart' (차트). Order in this array determines section order. Omit for all three.

options.description: 표시 옵션. 모두 optional, default 동작은 ON.

stripe.description: 그룹별 <ol> 안에서 항목 단위 zebra-striping (각 그룹 내 카운터 리셋).

SpacerBlock.description: Explicit vertical spacer. Default inter-block spacing is tight (8px). Insert a spacer block to add deliberate breathing room. `size` chooses the gap: sm=16px, md=32px (default), lg=64px, xl=128px.

DataSourceBlock.description: Live data block. Widget response shapes the data; render type fixes the renderer. For render=chart, the widget may include chartType / engine / interactions / options inline; chartOptions on the block deep-merges on top so document authors can override per-doc styling without touching the widget.

chartOptions.description: Per-document chart styling overrides (only for render=chart). Deep-merged ON TOP of widget-provided defaults — set just the fields you want to change.

options.description: Raw ECharts EChartsOption fragment, deep-merged after widget defaults + interactions.

imageId.description: FK to images table (mxwp-images). Camel-case to match ImageBlock; BE normalizes legacy 'image_id' on read.

label.description: Annotation label (was `text` pre-pass-2). BE normaliser rewrites legacy `text` → `label` on read.

bgColor.description: Optional callout label background colour. Default is white (hardcoded for readability on top of user images — see svg-block-audit cycle). Set to override (e.g. when the underlying image is uniformly bright and white blends in).

oneOf.description: 이미지 위 자유 위치 multi-line 텍스트 박스. callout(짧은 라벨) 과 달리 박스 크기 (w, h) 와 줄바꿈을 가진 본문성 주석. 이미지의 특정 영역을 설명하는 글을 직접 얹는 용도.

text.description: Multi-line plain text. \n 으로 줄 구분.

fontSize.description: 정규화 좌표계 기준 글자 크기 (기본 0.025). 좌표가 0-1 이라 일반적으로 0.015~0.06.

bg.description: 박스 배경색 (선택). 미지정 시 반투명 흰색 폴백.

cells.description: Sparse map of cell-ref → raw cell input (e.g. {'A1':'42', 'B2':'=SUM(A1:A10)'})

options.description: Visual rendering options. All fields optional with sensible defaults.

stripe.description: Zebra-striped data rows for readability. Default true; set false to disable. Header row is unaffected.

BibliographyBlock.description: Reference list (참고문헌). Citations elsewhere in the document use the [[cite:KEY]] inline syntax to anchor-link into entries here. Most often produced by the DOCX importer when it sees a 'References' / '참고문헌' / 'Bibliography' heading.

title.description: Optional override for the block heading. Defaults to '참고문헌' in the FE renderer.

style.description: Citation style label (numeric / alphabetic / author-year). Currently informational — the FE renders ordered list either way.

key.description: Optional citation key used by [[cite:KEY]] inline references. Alphanumeric / hyphen / underscore.

text.description: Formatted reference body — e.g. 'Smith, J. (2020). Foo bar. Journal of X, 3(2), 14-22.'

options.description: 표시 옵션. 모두 optional, default 동작은 ON.

stripe.description: 참고문헌 항목 단위 zebra-striping (각 entry 행).
